visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long wavy brown hair and a character hair clip eats a triangular sandwich while another woman with dark hair and bangs stands partially visible behind her. The background shows a domestic interior with shelves, storage containers, and kitchen items. The main woman chews enthusiastically. (2) The main woman holds two individually wrapped sandwiches with red and yellow branding up to the camera. She then uses her hands to peel back the white paper wrapping of one sandwich, revealing its triangular shape and layered contents of ham and cheese inside. (3) Three sandwich halves are placed inside the black drawer of a white kitchen appliance. A hand interacts with the digital touch screen on top of the appliance, adjusting the temperature to 180 and the timer to 4. The screen glows blue. (4) A hand uses a silver knife to scrape against the toasted, golden-brown surface of a triangular sandwich to demonstrate its dry texture. The camera zooms in closely on the sandwich layers, showing melted yellow cheese and pink ham slices. (5) Both women take large bites of the toasted sandwiches simultaneously. Animated pink heart icons and white radiant lines appear around their heads. They smile, nod, and look at each other while continuing to eat the food. The video ends with a summary graphic.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers a unique 'hack' for eating Hung Rui Chen sandwiches by using an air fryer. The intent is to show how to achieve a contrast between a crispy exterior and a cold interior, modeled after the 'ice and fire' pineapple bun concept.
